## Summary

- What does this PR change and why?

## Type of change

- [ ] feat (new feature)
- [ ] fix (bug fix)

- [ ] docs

## How was this tested?

- Commands run locally (`uv run ruff check`, `uv run mypy`, `uv run pytest`, ...)

## Checklist

      next line of each docstring/comment

- [ ] Docstrings on all public API (`ruff check` passes)
- [ ] Tests added/updated; `pytest` passes
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated (Unreleased section)
- [ ] No secrets, no new dependencies outside the licensing policy
      (MIT / BSD / Apache-2.0 / OFL only, see docs/LICENSING_POLICY.md)
